events.label: Kimi K3 full open-weight model release — 2.8T parameter model; second AI efficiency wave
events.note: Moonshot AI releases full Kimi K3 model weights (2.8 trillion parameters) publicly on July 27. Context updated July 24 night: INTC's full +12% earnings pop reversed to close down 7.89% at $92.32 on foundry external-demand scrutiny — a reminder that AI hardware demand narratives can reverse sharply in a single session. AAPL recovered +3.5% (services beat, China recovery thesis intact), providing a counterweight. VIX closed at 17.96 — still above the 17.00 upgrade trigger but below Thursday's 19.38, suggesting the market is somewhat less fragile entering Monday than feared Thursday night. Open-weight inference-efficiency models (Kimi K3 at 70% pricing discount vs. API providers) still directly challenge the hyperscaler inference-capex ROI thesis. Do not add NVDA or AMD into July 27 — the open-weight release is binary event risk on any GPU-exposed position, and INTC's reversal precedent this week shows AI hardware sentiment can flip on any single data point.

events.label: FOMC meeting (Jul 28-29) — Chair Warsh; July hike ~35%; September hike ~74%; oil diplomacy new variable
events.note: Updated as of July 24 night close: FOMC meets July 28-29 with Chair Kevin Warsh presiding (press conference 2:30pm ET July 29). July rate hike probability ~35%; July hold remains modal but live. September cumulative hike probability estimated ~74% (down from 82% Thursday as oil retreated sharply on Pakistan-China brokering of US-Iran talks). Brent $96.78 (down from $100.69 Thursday), WTI $89.31, VIX 17.96 (down from 19.38), 30Y at 5.11%. New inputs since morning brief: (1) Oil diplomacy — Pakistan and China are brokering US-Iran ceasefire framework talks (CNBC), a process signal that could reduce August CPI Brent component IF negotiations progress. (2) Trump tariffs on 99.4% of imports remain effective as of July 24. The FOMC September language is the single most market-moving variable of the year: dovish September language (Brent/tariff inflation transitory) = September hike falls to 45-55%, IWM/TLT relief; hawkish September language (compounding oil + tariff CPI embedding) = September hike above 85%, BEARISH regime via SPX below 7,380 likely. SPX closed at 7,411.98 — 31 pts from the BEARISH threshold.

events.label: FOMC Rate Decision (2pm ET) + META Q2 AH + MSFT Q2 AH — peak Q2 season density
events.note: FOMC rate decision (2pm ET, Chair Warsh press conference 2:30pm ET) plus two Magnificent Seven earnings after close. Note: AMZN reports July 30 AH (not July 29). Context as of July 24 night: GOOGL fell -7% on capex concerns; INTC reversed its full +12% AH earnings pop to close -7.89% at $92.32 on foundry external-demand scrutiny — a reminder that AI demand beats are insufficient if the ROI story is incomplete. META Q2 (first to quantify Bloomberg-reported AI cloud-to-third-parties business) is the key signal for whether AI monetization has crossed from cost center to revenue line. MSFT Azure must validate AMD Helios anchor-customer narrative with actual AI revenue growth. GOOGL and INTC experience suggests even genuine AI demand beats are overridden by capex-ROI concerns — META and MSFT must show credible monetization trajectories. Oil diplomacy (Pakistan-China brokering US-Iran talks) adds a new variable: if oil sustains below $95 Brent through July 29, September hike probability falls further, reducing the FOMC hawkish tail. If FOMC dovish AND META/MSFT beat on both revenue and ROI: first session since May that could reopen upgrade clock. If FOMC hawkish + any single disappointment: SPX tests 7,280-7,320.

events.label: AAPL Q2 AH + AMZN Q2 AH — services recovery vs. AWS hyperscaler demand read
events.note: AAPL and AMZN both report July 30 after close. Context as of July 24: AAPL already showed strength (+3.5% on July 24) on services beat and China recovery narrative heading into earnings — the stock is priced for a positive quarter. Key metrics: China iPhone units (YoY), services revenue (gross margin trajectory vs. App Store regulatory pressure), and any comment on AI monetization timeline. AMZN Q2 is the third hyperscaler AI demand read after GOOGL (AWS 82% YoY AI workload growth) and ahead of MSFT Azure (July 29). AWS is the largest cloud provider by revenue — its AI demand print sets the final Q2 hyperscaler baseline. AMZN also carries macro freight/logistics sensitivity: tariffs on 99.4% of imports (effective July 24) will be the first question on the call. If AAPL services beat AND AMZN AWS AI demand confirms GOOGL trajectory (above 80% YoY), this consolidates the Q2 AI demand thesis. If AAPL China disappoints OR AMZN cites tariff-related consumer demand softness, July 30 post-close could partially reverse July 29 gains.

events.label: July CPI (est.) — Brent $97-100 + Trump tariffs on 99.4% of imports; double inflation embedding
events.note: July CPI now has two major inflation inputs to absorb: (1) Brent crude at $97-100+ for 10+ consecutive sessions (gasoline follows Brent with a 2-3 week lag, fully embedding in the August CPI gasoline component); (2) Trump's new 10-12.5% tariffs on 60 trading partners (99.4% of US imports), effective July 24 — the most broad-based tariff action of the Trump 2.0 era, adding import cost pressure across consumer goods, autos, and industrial inputs. September cumulative hike probability entering July 24 is ~70%. A July CPI print above 3.5% YoY (incorporating oil $97-100 AND tariff import pass-through) makes September 25-50bps near-certain and would push September hike probability above 85%. Bull scenario (July CPI ≤3.2% with oil-shock and tariffs not yet embedding in core): September probability falls below 50%, rate-relief regime opens. Bear scenario (July CPI ≥3.8% YoY on dual oil+tariff pass-through): September 50bps probability approaches 90%, BEARISH regime confirmed through Q4. This print has the most adverse pre-positioning of any CPI release in the briefing series.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — must address AMD hyperscaler sweep + Kimi K3 + TSMC wafer hike
events.note: NVDA Q2 FY27 is the fundamental clearing event for the AI GPU thesis. $91B revenue guidance represents sequential acceleration. Context updated July 23: (1) AMD keynote confirmed all four major hyperscalers (OpenAI, Meta, MSFT Azure, Oracle, Anthropic 2GW) as Helios customers — the most credible competitive diversification from Nvidia in the AI cycle's history; (2) INTC Q2 Data Center +59% shows enterprise AI demand is broad-based, reducing single-vendor concentration risk; (3) Kimi K3 full open weights released July 27 — demand impact must be quantified; (4) TSMC wafer hike unresolved; (5) Brent $100 and September hike at 82% create macro headwinds for growth multiples. Hard stop $195 intact; do not add until Q2 FY27 addresses all five factors with data.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since June 12 IPO. Re-entry gate $115-120 for risk-tolerant 12-month investors. Net losses structural ($4.9B in 2025). December 2026 lock-up expiry adds supply overhang. Watch Starlink ARR growth and Starship launch cadence as primary metrics.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs. Early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst.
